title: GROUP BY: totals per category
why_it_matters: Dashboards and reports are built on it.
explanation: GROUP BY collapses rows that share a value into one row. Combine it with aggregates like count, sum, avg, min and max. Every selected column must either be in the group or inside an aggregate.
code:
select booking_id,
       count(*) as payments,
       sum(amount_cents) as paid
from payments
group by booking_id;
try_it: Count how many posts each author has written.
